### core-stays-generic

- Identity: ["project.markitect.example.org/v1alpha1","Statement","product","core-stays-generic"]
- Category: architecture
- Responsible Manager: ["project.markitect.example.org/v1alpha1","Manager","product","product"]
- Source: [.markitect/model/product/core-stays-generic.yaml](../../.markitect/model/product/core-stays-generic.yaml)

Core stays generic. It does not depend on Modules, Host, CLI, adopting repositories or model providers. A capability Module imports only Core and its own subtree. Host composes; CLI entrypoints delegate to Host. The import gate in `src/internal/tooling/architecture` enforces these directions; do not add exceptions to it.
